bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, six phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.5 (Durable storage) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.5's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `loads` reads format 1 and still refuses others with `unsupported format` (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_format1`)
after a load `LoanDesk.restore` makes the next loan id continue and `get_loan` finds loans (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_loan_ids`)
members carry `balance_cents` that blocks checkout at `FEE_BLOCK_CENTS` and survives a save (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_balances`)
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: storage.loads reads format 1 documents through an explicit upgrade step, still reads format 2, and refuses any other format with ValueError `unsupported format` (tests/test_format1.py).
`LoanDesk.restore` takes the loaded loans and sets the next loan id past the highest loaded one; today loads assigns desk.loans directly and leaves the next id at 1, so new loans reuse ids.
`get_loan(loan_id)` is a public lookup that raises NotFound for an unknown id (tests/test_loan_ids.py).
Member gains `balance_cents` defaulting to 0, written by dumps and read back with the default for documents that lack it.
`FEE_BLOCK_CENTS` is a new constant in shelf/policy.py and checkout refuses a member whose balance_cents reaches it with a ShelfError (tests/test_balances.py).
Holds saved by phase 1.4 still round trip through dumps and loads.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
